holds_conservation_ck.name: holds_conservation_ck
holds_conservation_ck.value: funded_minor >= 0 AND released_minor >= 0 AND returned_minor >= 0 AND released_minor + returned_minor <= funded_minor

milestones_locked_ck.name: milestones_locked_ck
milestones_locked_ck.value: state = 'DRAFT' OR locked_version_id IS NOT NULL

milestones_state_hold_ck.name: milestones_state_hold_ck
milestones_state_hold_ck.value:
CASE state
        WHEN 'DRAFT' THEN hold_status = 'NONE'
        WHEN 'APPROVED' THEN hold_status IN ('NONE', 'ORDER_CREATED', 'EXPIRED', 'VOIDED')
        WHEN 'RELEASED' THEN hold_status IN ('CAPTURE_PENDING', 'CAPTURED', 'CAPTURE_FAILED')
        WHEN 'CLOSED' THEN hold_status IN ('VOID_PENDING', 'VOIDED', 'EXPIRED')
        WHEN 'VOIDED' THEN hold_status IN ('NONE', 'VOID_PENDING', 'VOIDED', 'EXPIRED')
        ELSE hold_status IN ('AUTHORIZED', 'EXPIRED')
      END

milestones_terminal_settled_ck.name: milestones_terminal_settled_ck

releases_amount_ck.name: releases_amount_ck
